block: this project is best experienced on a laptop or desktop, in fullscreen mode.
it is not optimised for mobile.
it uses audio, and headphones are recommended.
it lasts around 20 minutes, depending on the letter speed.
the letter speed can be adjusted by pressing the ▼ and ▲ keys on your keyboard.
a speed indicator bar should briefly appear at the bottom right corner of your screen.
progress is not saved and refreshing starts anew.
